nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: Which region's atmospheric circulation patterns were notably altered due to sea ice reduction?
nodes.answer: The Barents Sea in the Arctic experienced altered atmospheric circulation patterns due to significant sea ice reduction.

nodes.label: Taxonomy
nodes.question: What is the geographical definition of the Arctic region?
nodes.answer: The Arctic region is defined as the land north of the Arctic Circle (66°30' N latitude) or, in Canada, north of 60° N.
